property.description: A rare offering in East Paramus, this exceptional custom-built estate sits on approx. 0.7 ac flat lot on a cul-de-sac, offering unmatched privacy, scale & contemporary luxury. Completed in late 2023 & presented in like-new condition, this 8,000sf residence features impeccably finished living space plus oversized 3car garage w/high ceilings for vehicle lifts. Striking U-shaped architecture surrounds the outdoor living area, creating seamless indoor/outdoor flow for everyday living & entertainment. Dramatic 2 story foyer opens to impressive great rm w/soaring ceilings & walls of glass. Designer kitchen features premium JennAir appls., waterfall island, butler's pantry, walk-in pantry. Main level offers 2 offices & expansive covered/open-air entmt. areas complete w/outdoor kit & BBQ. Luxurious primary suite offers dual oversized WICs & spa-inspired bath. 3 add'l ensuite BRs & dedicated laundry rm. Finished basement designed for today's luxury lifestyle, featuring home theater w/150-in screen & laser projector, fitness studio, dance studio/playroom, guest suite, wetbar & storage. Premium amenities include full-house generator,5-zone smart HVAC, lighting, irrigation, home audio & surveillance systems, professional landscaping, oversized paver driveway & ample room for future resort-style pool. Ideally located near premier shopping, dining, golf, parks & major highways, this is an extraordinary opportunity to own one of Bergen County's most compelling contemporary luxury offerings.
